name: skill-staleness-check
description: Use when an upstream release lands that a skill describes (a dependency or CLI upgrade, a GSD update, an API or config schema change), and when you author a skill that contains version-specific facts. Version-specific guidance can go stale at a release with no signal and keeps being followed. Tie each skill to the release it describes, and on an upgrade read the upstream change against every skill that names a changed surface, removing or correcting only what the change invalidates and leaving valid guidance alone. Distinct from skill-frontmatter-doctor (frontmatter defects) and operational-anchor-preservation (shortening a body). Backed by Repo2Skill-Evo (arxiv 2608.21964). Triggers on dependency upgrades and on version-specific skill content.
